column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Fitting” is rendered “becoming.”
Close to the Hebrew; “To his understanding there is no number” is rendered “His understanding is infinite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Relieving” is rendered “supports,” and “humble people” as “the afflicted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Harp” is rendered “lyre.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Taking pleasure in” is rendered “favors,” and “hope for” as “wait for.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Extol” is rendered “Praise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Makes your territory peace” is rendered “makes peace in your borders.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His word” is rendered “His command.”
